common.ministry: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India

home.title: What do you need?
home.intro: Choose what happened. Every option leads to the right team.
home.alertBody: Fake emails are being sent impersonating officials of I4C and related agencies. Government officers will never ask you for money, OTPs, or passwords.

victim.title: I lost money or I am a victim
victim.description: Money taken from your account, a fraudulent transaction, or a scam call.

harmfulContent.title: I need to report harmful content
harmfulContent.description: A fake profile using your photos, obscene material, or content involving women or children.

check.title: I want to check a person or website
check.description: See whether a phone number, email, website, or social media handle has been reported before.

track.title: I already reported
track.description: Check the status of a complaint using your acknowledgement number.

help.title: I need help
help.description: Read answers to common questions or contact the cyber cell in your State or UT.

hero.eyebrow: Government of India · Ministry of Home Affairs
hero.title: Report cybercrime. Get help fast.
hero.subtitle: Every complaint reaches the cyber cell for your State or Union Territory. Reporting is free, and you can report without giving your name.
hero.helplineTitle: Lost money in the last few hours?
hero.helplineBody: Call 1930 before you do anything else. Fast reporting is what makes it possible to freeze the money.

home.tasksIntro: Each option takes you to the right team.

how.step1Body: Give what you know. You will receive an acknowledgement number — save it.
how.step2Title: It reaches your State cyber cell
how.step2Body: Your complaint is routed to the police unit that has jurisdiction over your area.
how.step3Body: Use your acknowledgement number to check the status at any time.

home.helpBody: Read answers to common questions, or contact the cyber cell in your State or Union Territory directly.

report.title: Report an incident
report.intro: Choose the category that best describes what happened.

financialFraud.title: Financial fraud
financialFraud.description: Money debited without consent, UPI or card fraud, investment or job scams.

womenChildren.title: Crime against women or children
womenChildren.description: Obscene content, sexual abuse material, harassment, or stalking.

other.title: Other cyber crime
other.description: Hacking, data theft, ransomware, fake profiles, or online abuse.

report.urgentTitle: If money was taken from your account
report.urgentBody: Call 1930 immediately. The sooner you report, the higher the chance of freezing the funds.

track.title: Track your complaint
track.intro: You will need the acknowledgement number you received when you reported.
track.ackHint: The number sent to you when you filed the complaint, for example 12345678901234.
track.requestOtp: Send OTP to my registered mobile
track.otpSentStatus: We sent a one-time password to the mobile number ending {last4}.
track.otpDisabledHint: This field becomes available after you request an OTP.
track.captchaHint: Type the characters shown in the image.

errors.ackFormat: The acknowledgement number should be 14 digits.
errors.otpFormat: The OTP should be six digits.
errors.notFound: We could not find a complaint with that acknowledgement number.

checkSuspect.title: Check a suspect
checkSuspect.intro: Search whether an identifier has been reported to the portal before. A result is not proof of a crime.
checkSuspect.identifierLabel: Phone number, email, or social media handle
checkSuspect.identifierHint: Enter one identifier at a time.
checkSuspect.websiteHint: For example, example.com or the name of an app.
checkSuspect.noResults: No reports found for this identifier.
checkSuspect.disclaimer: The absence of a result does not mean an identifier is safe.

reportSuspect.title: Report a suspect
reportSuspect.intro: Report an identifier you believe is being used for cyber crime.
reportSuspect.victimBody: If you have lost money or suffered harm, file a complaint instead. Reporting a suspect alone does not start an investigation into your case.
reportSuspect.typeHint: Choose the option closest to what you saw.
reportSuspect.stateHint: This routes your report to the correct cyber cell.

contacts.title: Cyber cell contacts by State and UT
contacts.intro: Find the nodal cyber cell officer and grievance officer for your State or Union Territory.
contacts.selectLabel: Select your State or Union Territory
contacts.escalationNote: If you used Report and Track and are not satisfied with the response, you may escalate to your State or UT officer.
contacts.tableCaption: Nodal cyber cell and grievance officers for every State and Union Territory

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Search for a question or browse by topic.
faq.searchHint: For example, OTP, evidence, or withdraw.
